notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new unlockable costumes
[*] Fixed issue with scrolling when too many save files exist
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential bug when transferring troops between commanders in other realms.
[*] Fixed a few German translation errors.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented unlocking the research achievement.
[*] Fixed a bug where a commander would not level up if Continue was pressed before the XP bar filled and the "LV UP+" message appeared.
[*] Fixed a bug where farms provided more resources than intended in Mission Mode.
[*] Fixed a rare bug causing superbosses to spawn outside the map.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Doomslayer research bonus was applied incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could sometimes attack an allied tent.
[*] Hermes ability now works when equipped via an item.
[*] Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when removing units in other realms.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added German translation (note: English save files are not compatible)
[*] Portals and towers can no longer be built on Ether Streams
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect AP display for movement
[*] Fixed potential crash when switching realms
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an option to highlight buildings that can be constructed.
[*] Units from commanders can now be transferred back to the town.
[*] Added special options when transferring units, such as Mark All, Mark Range, etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an option to adjust resource spot density.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Resolution, music, and sound volume are now saved in the global settings.
[*] Activating resource spots no longer prevents achievements, but you need to start a new game for the change to take effect.
[/list]
